before: Central-directory and required APK core content read only. APK/OBB non-core local member header could disagree with central directory; ZipFile.namelist shows central name, but ZipFile.open fails (BadZipFile). Adjacent manifest recomputed over corrupted bytes would match.
after: Every local ZIP header inspected without decompressing original bytes: PK signature/name/flags/compression, CRC and non-descriptor sizes, compressed region inside central directory and no overlap with neighboring header. ZIP64 placeholder and legal streamed data descriptor accepted.
limitations: Not actual original signed delivery XAPK/APK/OBB, no inner SHA and certificate verification.
No Unity OBB internal GUID or Android phone mount, no actual pixel/water/FFT proof.
A local untrusted delivery manifest is not an authenticated origin.
One pass of metadata does not guarantee full CRC/check of all compressed streams.
next_step: Run stricter checker on actual source-authenticated signed APK and OBB from original owner-tested delivery if authorized memory/disk and provenance, then cryptographic signature and versionCode check independently, without claiming device acceptance.
